voss.prompt:
Production game HUD architectural frame sprite sheet. scratched antique bronze and dark iron, layered ragged crimson cloth, restrained tiny skull and ammunition motifs, strong angular blades. TWO separate wide horizontal console shells stacked vertically on genuine transparent background, lots of space between; no letters, text, icons, portraits, controls or numbers. Each complete frame is approx 3.2:1 width to height. Premium dark fantasy painted UI materials and intricate golden edging matching existing voss plates.
TOP: left HUD console, continuous outer carved frame wrapping the entire left edge of a HUD. Rich decoration around its left border and top/bottom rails. Inside is one unobstructed dark textured recessed panel, designed to hold a minimap left 25%, portrait middle 25%, name and health right 50%. DO NOT draw inner widget frames or placeholders. Dark inset must be blank and unobstructed. Ornament stays only in a narrow outer 6% border; dramatic upper edge decoration may project OUTWARD ABOVE the panel.
BOTTOM: right HUD console shell. Designed as a unified architectural housing for inventory left 53% and a vertically stacked utility bank right 42%. One spacious blank dark textured inset. A beautifully carved crescent/bladed arc wraps the entire outer RIGHT boundary, gold corners and connected carved top and bottom rails. The crescent is concentrated OUTSIDE the dark inset, with dark usable interior spanning x 7% to 93% and y 18% to 88%. Keep central inset COMPLETELY CLEAR; every control must fit inside its outer silhouette. Existing plate sprites will be overlaid inside. No inner boxes or fake slots.
Both pieces closed complete outer outlines, same scale and detail, no loose decoration. Theme-specific ornaments follow the requested materials. Nothing cropped. True alpha around both sprite silhouettes.
